lead.headline: Ethereum Prepares for Post-Merge Scale Rebuild
lead.tldr: Vitalik Buterin signals a multi-year architectural overhaul focused on quantum safety, coinciding with a massive spike in ETH outflows from centralized exchanges.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum's next rebuild will rival the Merge, and take three to four years
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin announced that Ethereum is planning a major rebuild over the next three to four years that will be comparable in scale to the Merge. A primary focus of this upcoming phase is increasing the network's quantum safety.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A three-to-four year timeline for a 'Merge-scale' rebuild suggests a long-term shift toward quantum resistance, signaling that Ethereum is prioritizing systemic longevity over short-term feature shipping.

top_signals.title: Binance outflows triple to $1.2B as ETH withdrawals hit 3-year high25m, Binance outflows triple to $1.2B as ETH withdrawals hit 3-year highBinance recorded $1.23 billion in weekly net outflows, up 207% from the previous week, as Ethereum withdrawals surged to a three-year high.
top_signals.summary: Binance experienced a massive surge in net outflows, totaling $1.23 billion in a single week. This spike was driven primarily by Ethereum withdrawals reaching their highest level in three years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $1.23B net outflow from Binance indicates a strong trend toward self-custody or DeFi migration, reducing exchange-side concentration risk for ETH holders.

top_signals.title: Moonbeam Pivots From Polkadot to Base to Build AI Agents
top_signals.summary: Moonbeam is pivoting its strategic focus away from Polkadot after four years to migrate to Base, an Ethereum Layer 2. The project aims to build a specialized communication and settlement network specifically for AI agents.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Moonbeam's pivot to Base highlights the growing gravity of the Coinbase ecosystem for AI-agent infrastructure over the Polkadot parachain model.

top_signals.title: The new stack for global finance: Stablecoins edition
top_signals.why_it_matters: The evolution of stablecoin stacks remains the primary bridge for integrating legacy global finance with on-chain settlement.

top_signals.title: South Africa’s Tax Authority Proposes Crypto Tax Guidance
top_signals.summary: South Africa's tax authority, SARS, has released draft guidance to clarify the application of income and capital gains tax to crypto assets. The move aims to provide a clearer framework for taxpayers operating within the digital asset space.
top_signals.why_it_matters: South Africa's move toward formal tax guidance reduces operational uncertainty for institutional players entering the region.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin ETFs log record eighth straight negative week despite large Thursday inflow
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have experienced their eighth consecutive week of negative flows. Despite a large inflow on Thursday, the overall trend remains downward.

on_the_radar.title: Central bankers sound alarms over agentic AI finance risks25m, Central bankers sound alarms over agentic AI finance risks“We need to think about new tools and a different way of working with the [AI] market in a more collaborative way,” says Nikhil Rathi, CEO of the UK’s finance watchdog.
on_the_radar.summary: Central bankers and financial regulators are warning about the systemic risks posed by agentic AI in the financial sector. Nikhil Rathi of the UK's finance watchdog emphasizes the need for new collaborative tools to manage these emerging market risks.

on_the_radar.title: Trump Memecoin Puts 1M Holders at Losses of $3.8B
on_the_radar.summary: A memecoin associated with Donald Trump has resulted in losses totaling $3.8 billion for approximately one million holders. Data from Nansen indicates that while the vast majority of investors lost money, a small group of early buyers secured significant profits.

on_the_radar.title: Nigel Farage failed to declare funding from crypto gambling figure convicted of fraud: Sunday Times
on_the_radar.summary: Nigel Farage is reportedly under scrutiny for failing to declare funding from a convicted crypto gambling fraudster. He is also facing a parliamentary investigation regarding a £5 million gift from Tether stakeholder Christopher Harborne.

linkedin_post: Moonbeam's decision to pivot from Polkadot to Base after four years is a telling signal about where the actual liquidity and developer momentum for AI agents currently reside. While Polkadot offered a distinct vision of cross-chain interoperability, the reality is that the Base ecosystem provides a more direct path to distribution and a tighter integration with the Ethereum L2 stack. I'd watch how this migration affects the settlement layer for AI agents; moving to a specialized communication network on Base suggests that the priority has shifted from 'sovereign chains' to 'integrated liquidity.' It is a pragmatic move that acknowledges the current market preference for the Ethereum-centric orbit over the fragmented landscape of independent relay chains.
